name: @askrjs/charts
description: Typed Canvas 2D plots and SVG export for Askr applications.

scripts.bench: npm run bench:tier1 && npm run bench:tier2 && npm run bench:tier3 && npm run bench:tier4
scripts.bench:tier1: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vp test bench --run --reporter=default --config vitest.bench.tier1.config.ts
scripts.bench:tier2: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vp test bench --run --reporter=default --config vitest.bench.tier2.config.ts
scripts.bench:tier3: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vp test bench --run --config vitest.bench.tier3.config.ts
scripts.bench:tier4: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vp test bench --run --config vitest.bench.tier4.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:checks && npm run test:jsdom && npm run test:browser && npm run test:visual
scripts.test:browser: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vp test run -c vitest.test.browser.config.ts
scripts.test:visual: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vp test run -c vitest.test.visual.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:types && npm run test:installed && npm run test:publint && npm run pack:check
